content_text:
Dear Mr Deakins,
what can you say about these two colleagues of yours and maybe on some younger ones like Pawel Pogorzelski? And have you seen maybe the movie Ruined Heart, director Khavn de la Cruz and shot by C. Doyle with maybe the most beautiful sequence ever shot? 🙂
